sentences.text: Researchers investigated whether adding valproic acid to temozolomide improves brain tumor treatment by altering gene regulation, using a model of 60 male rats with implanted tumor cells divided into six groups receiving various drug combinations.
Scientists measured specific RNA and protein markers in the brain tissue, finding that the combined drug use raised miR-124-3p levels and lowered Sp1 levels more than either drug alone.
The authors conclude that it remains unproven whether targeting these molecules will function as a therapy or if epigenetic changes caused the observed results.
